summary: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results. The release details revenues of $26.8 million (up 23% YoY), mine operating income of $13.0 million, net income of $10.9 million ($0.06 per diluted share), and operating cash flow of $13.3 million. The company highlighted progress at its La Preciosa project. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or strategic actions. The filing is informational only, with no deal terms or corporate events.
